item.title: Nearly one in four Chatham-Kent families facing food insecurity
item.description: Almost a quarter of households in Chatham-Kent struggle to afford food due to low income, the board of health heard Monday. According to data from Public Health Ontario collected in 2023-2024, 23.4 per cent of families in Chatham-Kent are food insecure. Those families worry about food running out, have a limited selection of food, have missed meals […]
